_note: Dashboard settings (no secrets). Credentials go in .env or the encrypted local vault (Settings page). Edit accounts in the dashboard or below; IDs of our own public accounts are not secret.

accounts.label: Instagram ES
accounts._note: Spanish Instagram is added later; set active true and a handle then.

instagram._check: Confirm the current Graph API version at developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/changelog before the first live run.

sharing._note: Applied by `ss dash export --share`. Own-account analytics are the owner's data; sharing them with AI tools for internal analysis follows the owner's 2026-11-24 decision for YouTube public stats, extended here to own accounts pending owner confirmation. Twitch follows config/research/settings.json twitch.share_exports.

publishing._note: Publishing to our own accounts (docs/dashboard/publishing.md). Every upload needs the owner's approval in the dashboard (typing the account handle). Visibility and the reveal lock are separate: public_posting allows posts others can see; reveal_lock keeps the game's identity hidden whatever the visibility (text matching reveal_terms blocks any non-private post, and the owner confirms at approval that the video doesn't reveal the game). Only the owner turns reveal_lock off. tiktok_app_audited stays false until TikTok audits the app (Direct Post is then SELF_ONLY on private accounts only; public TikTok posts go through Upload to inbox).

hosting._note: Cloudinary free plan, only for handing approved videos to Buffer. Uploads stop at these limits (well inside the free plan); the plan is never changed. Files are deleted when every Buffer post of them has finished; abandoned ones after abandon_hours.
